targets.rawSql:
with deltas as (
  select
    source_database,
    inst_id,
    sql_id,
    child_number,
    plan_hash_value,
    max(coalesce(elapsed_time_micro, 0)) - min(coalesce(elapsed_time_micro, 0)) as elapsed_micro_delta,
    max(coalesce(cpu_time_micro, 0)) - min(coalesce(cpu_time_micro, 0)) as cpu_micro_delta,
    max(coalesce(user_io_wait_micro, 0)) - min(coalesce(user_io_wait_micro, 0)) as user_io_micro_delta,
    max(coalesce(executions, 0)) - min(coalesce(executions, 0)) as executions_delta,
    max(coalesce(buffer_gets, 0)) - min(coalesce(buffer_gets, 0)) as buffer_gets_delta,
    max(coalesce(disk_reads, 0)) - min(coalesce(disk_reads, 0)) as disk_reads_delta,
    max(parsing_schema_name) as parsing_schema_name,
    max(module) as module
  from oracle_sql_samples
  where $__timeFilter(collected_at)
    and source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
  group by source_database, inst_id, sql_id, child_number, plan_hash_value
)
select
  inst_id,
  sql_id,
  child_number,
  plan_hash_value,
  round(elapsed_micro_delta / 1000000.0, 3) as elapsed_seconds_delta,
  round(cpu_micro_delta / 1000000.0, 3) as cpu_seconds_delta,
  round(user_io_micro_delta / 1000000.0, 3) as user_io_seconds_delta,
  executions_delta,
  buffer_gets_delta,
  disk_reads_delta,
  parsing_schema_name,
  module,
  left((select t.sql_fulltext from oracle_sql_texts t where t.source_database = deltas.source_database and t.sql_id = deltas.sql_id), 240) as sql_preview
from deltas
where elapsed_micro_delta > 0
order by elapsed_micro_delta desc
limit 50;

targets.rawSql:
with deltas as (
  select
    source_database,
    inst_id,
    sql_id,
    child_number,
    plan_hash_value,
    max(coalesce(elapsed_time_micro, 0)) - min(coalesce(elapsed_time_micro, 0)) as elapsed_micro_delta,
    max(coalesce(executions, 0)) - min(coalesce(executions, 0)) as executions_delta,
    max(coalesce(buffer_gets, 0)) - min(coalesce(buffer_gets, 0)) as buffer_gets_delta,
    max(coalesce(disk_reads, 0)) - min(coalesce(disk_reads, 0)) as disk_reads_delta,
    max(coalesce(rows_processed, 0)) - min(coalesce(rows_processed, 0)) as rows_processed_delta,
    max(parsing_schema_name) as parsing_schema_name,
    max(module) as module
  from oracle_sql_samples
  where $__timeFilter(collected_at)
    and source_database = ${source_database:sqlstring}
  group by source_database, inst_id, sql_id, child_number, plan_hash_value
)
select
  inst_id,
  sql_id,
  child_number,
  plan_hash_value,
  executions_delta,
  rows_processed_delta,
  round((elapsed_micro_delta / 1000000.0) / nullif(executions_delta, 0), 6) as elapsed_seconds_per_exec,
  round(buffer_gets_delta::numeric / nullif(rows_processed_delta, 0), 3) as buffer_gets_per_row,
  round(disk_reads_delta::numeric / nullif(executions_delta, 0), 3) as disk_reads_per_exec,
  parsing_schema_name,
  module,
  left((select t.sql_fulltext from oracle_sql_texts t where t.source_database = deltas.source_database and t.sql_id = deltas.sql_id), 240) as sql_preview
from deltas
where elapsed_micro_delta > 0
order by coalesce((elapsed_micro_delta / 1000000.0) / nullif(executions_delta, 0), 0) desc
limit 50;
